policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. Update measured counts in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances; never lower a floor without an explicit, justified scope change.

tolerance.rationale: Dismissible Smart Refresh notices add a state-watermarked dismissal latch, an additive active-server ShowNotices policy, accessible dual actions, and presentation-only suppression in core/live-update.ts. The legitimate core scope increase is 29 instrumented lines (2637→2666); compatibility, dismissal/retry/re-arm, live suppression, and Ask-mode regressions raise the reviewed high-water by 30 covered lines (2295→2325, 87.209%). Two clean Node 22.20/V8 full-suite coverage runs on 2026-07-25 each passed all 1483 tests across 214 files and reproduced exactly 2325/2666. Retaining the one-line tolerance makes the minimum 2324/2666 (87.172%), stricter than both the prior 2295/2637 high-water percentage (87.031%) and its 2294/2637 tolerated floor (86.993%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The Smart Refresh notice policy adds a default-on configuration property and atomic ShowNotices projection in ClientRefreshStateService. The legitimate server scope increase is five instrumented lines (28600→28605); service, legacy-XML migration, bootstrap contract, descriptor, binder, and golden-payload tests raise the reviewed high-water by five covered lines (20195→20200, 70.617%). Two clean .NET 10.0.9/Coverlet runs on 2026-07-25 each passed all 1804 tests across the complete assembly and measured 20199–20200 covered lines. The unchanged evidence-bounded five-line Coverlet tolerance makes the minimum 20195/28605 (70.600%), stricter than the prior tolerated floor of 20190/28600 (70.594%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
